# overlay upper bound

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayUpperBound`](gmeow-overlayUpperBound.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayUpperBound>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The upper bound of this regulatory overlay in a vertical dimension (altitude, depth, elevation), expressed as a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) with unit (QUDT) and reference frame. Optional: absent for purely 2D overlays. Frame-relative per [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) -> [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:overlayUpperBound`](gmeow-overlayUpperBound.md) from [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) to [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md), [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the upper vertical bound of an overlay as a frame-relative [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for purely 2D overlays and avoid omitting the vertical frame ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:overlayUpperBound`](gmeow-overlayUpperBound.md) at a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) with QUDT unit in an explicit vertical frame; pair with [`gmeow:overlayLowerBound`](gmeow-overlayLowerBound.md).
